meta.home_title: HoldMyTrack — Keep your GPX, FIT and TCX tracks on one map
meta.home_description: Upload and keep your GPX, FIT and TCX tracks from Garmin, Strava or any watch or app, and see every walk, run, ride and hike on one map with Fog of War. Free, open source, and your data is never sold.
meta.site_description: HoldMyTrack is a free, open-source place to see every outdoor activity you have ever recorded on one map — Fog of War and routes from your watch, phone or old exports.
meta.og_image_alt: A HoldMyTrack map of Cleveland: tracks across the city, with photos and nearby places marked on it.
meta.title: {page} — HoldMyTrack
meta.about_title: About HoldMyTrack — Keep your GPX, FIT and TCX tracks on one map
meta.help_description: How HoldMyTrack works: the map and its Normal and Fog of War modes, importing GPX, FIT and TCX files and the Android app, exporting a map image, and privacy settings.
meta.gpx_viewer_title: GPX, FIT and TCX viewer that keeps your tracks — HoldMyTrack
meta.gpx_viewer_description: Open GPX, FIT and TCX files on a map, colored by pace, and keep the tracks you care about together on one map of everywhere you have been. Free, with every feature in every account.
meta.import_garmin_title: Export Garmin activities to GPX and keep them on a map — HoldMyTrack
meta.import_garmin_description: How to export an activity from Garmin Connect as GPX, TCX or FIT, or take it straight from the watch, and keep your favorite hikes, rides and runs together on one map. Free.
meta.import_strava_title: Export Strava activities to GPX and keep them on a map — HoldMyTrack
meta.import_strava_description: How to export an activity from Strava as GPX or its original file, or pick from your Strava archive, and keep your favorite hikes, rides and runs together on one map. Free.
meta.fog_of_war_title: Fog of War map of everywhere you have been — HoldMyTrack
meta.fog_of_war_description: See every street, park and trail you have walked, run or ridden cleared out of the fog, from GPX, FIT and TCX files or the Android app, and find somewhere new close to home. Free.
meta.guides_description: How-to guides for HoldMyTrack: open GPX, FIT and TCX files on a map, export activities from Garmin and Strava, and see a Fog of War map of everywhere you have been.
meta.contacts_description: How to reach the HoldMyTrack project: email, code and issues.
meta.privacy_description: What HoldMyTrack keeps about you and why, who else handles it, how long it is kept, and how to get it back or deleted. No health data, no tracking, never sold.

settings.title: Settings
settings.onboarding_intro: Two things before your map: your country sets whether distances show in km or miles, and your timezone sets which day each track falls on. You can change both here later.
settings.demo_notice: This is the shared demo account, so its settings can't be changed. Create your own account to save yours.
settings.avatar_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
settings.name: Name
settings.country_hint: Decides whether distance, pace and elevation show in km/m or mi/ft, everywhere in the app.
settings.timezone_hint: Decides which day is today. Each track shows the date and time where it was recorded; this zone stands in when that place isn't known. Set automatically when you signed up; change it here if you've moved.
settings.theme_hint: In this browser only. Applies at once.
settings.usage_line: {tracks} of {max_tracks} tracks · {storage} of {max_storage} of original files
settings.usage_hint: The same for every account, far above what anyone records: they stop a runaway import, not you. Deleting tracks makes room.
settings.export_hint: A copy of everything in your account, as zip archives: the files you uploaded or synced, every track as GPX, your photos, and your settings, Trips, Private locations and captured places (what's inside).
settings.export_preparing: Preparing your archive. It usually takes a few minutes; we'll email {email} when it's ready, and it will be here too.
settings.export_failed: Your last download couldn't be prepared. Please try again, and if it fails again, let us know.
settings.delete_hint: Deletes your account and everything in it, for good: every track and the files you uploaded, your photos, Trips, Private locations and captured places. You're signed out everywhere at once. It can't be undone, and backups keep it for up to 8 weeks (privacy policy).
settings.delete_confirm: To confirm, type your email address, {email}

email.trip_copy.body:
{from} sent you a copy of their HoldMyTrack Trip “{trip}” ({tracks}).

Accept it and the Trip and its tracks become yours: they show on your map, in your Fog of War and in your totals, and they stay yours whatever happens to theirs. Accept or decline it in the Trips tab:

{link}

If you don't know who this is, decline it and nothing is added to your account.
export.readme:
Your HoldMyTrack data, as of {date}

If this download came in several zip archives, extract them all into the same folder: together they make one set of folders.

originals/  Every file you uploaded or synced, exactly as it arrived (GPX, FIT, TCX, or JSON for tracks synced from a phone). These are complete: Private locations haven't been applied to them.
tracks/     Every track as a GPX file, as your map shows it: with your Private locations cut away and your route edits applied.
photos/     The copy of each photo you added, as HoldMyTrack keeps it.
account.json  Your account and settings, every track's details and which files are its, your Trips, Private locations and captured places.

HoldMyTrack keeps no health data, so there is none here.
